name: Mountain Wolves
source:
This game is set in the present, where you enter the skin of Jamie Moore, a 26 year old chef who sells his body for money.

After a traumatic event, he returns to his hometown and family, only to find a terrible surprise waiting.

A werewolf novel about crimes and punishments of your actions...

[From [url=https://ducksanity1.itch.io/mountain-wolves]Itch.io[/url]]
